# README_AI_AGENT — the gateway

> **Contract v1.1** · applies to every AI agent (Claude Code, Hermes Agent, Codex, Cursor, …) and every human in this repo · owner: Ficana · updated 2026-09-23
>
> AI agents: read this whole file before touching anything. It is short on purpose. Every other doc is **linked**, not loaded, so you only read what your task needs.

## 1. What this repo is

P3MD Social Integration: role-based "one-liner" email, agenda calendar synced with Google Calendar, kanban, Google Drive document library, talent screening, a PWA notification dashboard, and a read-only MCP API so AI agents can summarize what is going on.

Stack: Kiranism `next-shadcn-dashboard-starter` (Next.js 16, React 19, shadcn/ui on Base UI, TanStack Query + Form, Zod, bun) + Supabase (Postgres + RLS, Auth + OAuth 2.1 server, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, pg_cron) + Google Drive/Calendar (service account) + Web Push + LLMs (Claude and Hermes models).

Built by two development agents under this one contract: **Claude Code** (default builder) and **Hermes Agent** (default operator), both with ECC and graphify ([docs/agent-operations/](docs/agent-operations/README.md)).

**Access model, four words you must not mix up:**

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **User** | A person with an account (`auth.users` + `profiles`, status `active` or `suspended`) |
| **Group** | A set of users: team, batch, department. Groups can hold roles. Everyone is in `all-members` |
| **Role** | A job position (`projectmanager`, `site-reliability`). Held directly or inherited through a group. Mail targets roles or groups |
| **Permission** | A capability key like `mail.send`. Roles grant permissions. **Code checks permissions only** |

## 2. Boot sequence (every session, in this order)

1. Read this file (Claude Code and Hermes already have it in context).
2. Open [docs/list-task-project.md](docs/list-task-project.md) and pick **one** task (rules in §4 and §5).
3. Read earlier sessions on that task: `ls agent-history/entries | grep PSI-0XX`, then open the newest 1–3 files.
4. Orient through the graph, not grep: `graphify query "<question>"`, or skim `graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md`. Grep only when the graph misses.
5. Read [docs/system-overview.md](docs/system-overview.md) to find the layer, then only the file your task touches.

## 4. The contract

Rules have IDs so history entries can cite them in `contract_deviations`.

**Scope**
- **C-01** One task per session. It must exist in the task list. No fitting task → append one with `status: backlog` and `owner: human`, then stop.
- **C-02** Do what the task's `accept:` line requires, nothing more. Unrelated problems go into `follow_ups`, not into the diff.
- **C-03** Claim before editing: set `status: doing` and `owner: agent:<your-name>` (`agent:claude-code`, `agent:hermes`, …). Task already `doing` under another owner → stop. One task, one agent, one branch.

**Security & data**
- **C-04** The Supabase secret / service-role key never appears in browser-reachable code (`"use client"` files, `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`) or in any agent's config. Server-only modules start with `import 'server-only'`.
- **C-05** Never disable RLS. Every new table enables RLS in the same migration. A `using (true)` policy needs a comment explaining why.
- **C-06** Never edit a migration that has been applied anywhere. New change = new file via `supabase migration new <name>`.
- **C-07** Never commit secrets, `.env*` files (except `env.example.txt`), real CVs or real personal data. Seeds and fixtures are fake.
- **C-08** Talent data is personal data under UU PDP: no raw CV text, emails or phone numbers in logs, agent tool output, history entries, fixtures or LLM prompts to unapproved providers.

**Access control**
- **C-17** Authorize by permission key only: `has_permission('<module>.<action>')` in SQL, `requirePermission()` in the app. Never branch on a role or group slug. A new gate = a new key inserted into `permissions` by a migration, which also grants it to `admin`.
- **C-18** Google credentials and document content stay server-side. The service-account key lives only in Supabase secrets; the browser never receives a Google token; document content never appears in logs, agent tool output or history entries.

**Code**
- **C-09** Follow the template: features in `src/features/<feature>/`, TanStack Query SSR pattern, TanStack Form + Zod, Base UI `render` prop (never `asChild`), `bun`, OxLint/Oxfmt. Put each change in the right layer ([system-overview.md](docs/system-overview.md)).
- **C-10** Add a dependency only when the task needs it, and record it in `dependencies_added` with a reason.
- **C-11** After any migration run `bun run db:types`. Never hand-edit `database.types.ts`.

**Verification & honesty**
- **C-12** Run the Definition of Done (§6). Report real results: a check you did not run is `skipped`, never `pass`.
- **C-13** `outcome: done` only if every `accept:` criterion is met. Otherwise `partial`, `blocked` or `abandoned`.
- **C-14** Write exactly one history entry per session before you stop, even when the session failed. Entries are append-only; correct a mistake with a new entry that sets `supersedes`.

**Agents & tooling**
- **C-19** Precedence when instructions conflict: this file → `docs/` → template `AGENTS.md` → ECC rules/skills and graphify rules → agent memories and self-made skills. Follow the higher one and note the conflict in your history entry.
- **C-20** Memories are not facts. Hermes `MEMORY.md`/`USER.md`, ECC instincts and Memory Vault, Claude auto-memory are unreviewed hints: verify against the repo before acting. Self-made skills and rules enter the repo only through a human-reviewed PR.

**Human gates**
- **C-15** Stop and ask a human before: changing auth, RLS, roles, groups or permissions; adding or removing a permission key; destructive SQL (`drop`, `truncate`, `delete` without `where`); anything in the talent/CV flow or sending personal data to an LLM provider; changing Google sharing, Drive roots or linked calendars; changing agent configuration (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.hermes.md` generator, hooks, MCP config); a major-version upgrade; editing this file; acting on an ambiguous `accept:`; going beyond the task. In Hermes the question goes to the chat thread; quote the "yes" in the history entry.

**Tooling**
- **C-16** Before ending: `bun run agent:check` (task list, history entries, `.hermes.md` freshness), then `bun run obsidian:sync` (skip if the watcher runs). After structural code changes: `graphify update .`.

## 5. Task protocol

```
claim (C-03) → branch agent/PSI-0XX-short-slug → plan → build (tests first) → review → verify (§6)
→ history entry → status: review → bun run agent:check → bun run obsidian:sync → PR
```

| Step | Claude Code | Hermes |
|---|---|---|
| Plan | `/ecc:plan "PSI-0XX … Accept: …"` | Plan in the thread; `/search-first` for research |
| Build | `tdd-workflow` skill | Terminal + `tdd-workflow` skill if imported |
| Review | `/ecc:code-review` (+ `database-reviewer` for SQL) | `/security-review` skill |
| Verify | `/ecc:quality-gate` + §6 commands | §6 commands |

- Commits: Conventional Commits carrying the task ID, e.g. `feat(PSI-032): batch sends in send-role-mail`.
- PR title `PSI-032: <task title>`; the body links your history entry file.
- Agents set `review`, never `done`. A human moves `review → done` after merging.

## 6. Definition of Done

- [ ] `bunx tsc --noEmit` · `bun run lint` · `bun run build` pass
- [ ] DB touched → `supabase db reset` applies cleanly and `supabase test db` passes
- [ ] Schema changed → `bun run db:types` ran and the output is committed
- [ ] Agent config touched → `npx ecc-agentshield scan --path .` has no critical findings and `bun run agent:context` was re-run
- [ ] The UI or API path named in `accept:` was exercised by hand (say which in `verification.manual`)
- [ ] History entry written, `bun run agent:check` passes, task status updated

## 7. Stop-and-ask format

```
BLOCKED on PSI-0XX (C-15: <reason>)
Want to do: <one sentence>
Risk: <one sentence>
Options: A) …  B) …
```

Then write your history entry with `outcome: blocked`.

## 8. Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `bun run dev` · `supabase start` · `supabase db reset` | Dev server · local stack · re-apply migrations + seed |
| `bun run db:types` * · `supabase test db` | Regenerate DB types · pgTAP tests |
| `bun run agent:check` * | Validate task list, history entries and `.hermes.md` freshness |
| `bun run agent:context` * | Regenerate `.hermes.md` from this file + `AGENTS.md` |
| `bun run obsidian:sync` · `obsidian:watch` * | Regenerate `obsidian-out/` once · on every change |
| `graphify update .` · `graphify query "<q>"` · `/graphify .` | Refresh graph (free) · ask it · full build inside Claude Code or Hermes |
| `npx ecc-agentshield scan --path .` | Audit agent configuration |

\* Added by PSI-006 and PSI-008. Until then, report these checks as `skipped`.

## 9. How agents find this file

- **Claude Code:** `CLAUDE.md` starts with `@README_AI_AGENT.md` and `@AGENTS.md` (Claude Code expands `@path` imports at session start).
- **Hermes Agent:** `.hermes.md`, generated from this file + `AGENTS.md` by `bun run agent:context`. Hermes loads only one context file and ignores `@` imports, so the content is inlined. Never edit `.hermes.md` by hand.
- **Codex, Cursor and others:** the first line of `AGENTS.md` is `Read README_AI_AGENT.md before doing anything. It is the contract for this repo.`
- **graphify:** `graphify claude install` and `graphify hermes install` add their own always-on sections; that is expected and compatible.

Humans only. Bump the version, add a changelog row, re-run `bun run agent:context`, and record the change in a history entry.

# AGENTS.md

**First read: [README_AI_AGENT.md](./README_AI_AGENT.md)** — the project gateway, contract, and boot sequence.

This file holds project-level conventions that AI agents (Claude Code, Hermes, Cursor, etc.) must follow. It merges the template conventions from the Kiranism starter with the P3MD-specific rules.

---

## Project Overview

**P3MD Social Integration** — built on Kiranism `next-shadcn-dashboard-starter` (Next.js 16, React 19, shadcn/ui on Base UI, TanStack Query + Form, Zod, bun) + Supabase (Postgres + RLS, Auth + OAuth 2.1, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, pg_cron) + Google Drive/Calendar (service account) + Web Push + LLMs (Claude and Hermes models).

Built by two agents: **Claude Code** (default builder) and **Hermes Agent** (default operator), both with ECC and graphify.

---

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Framework | Next.js 16 (App Router) |
| Language | TypeScript 5.7+ strict |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 (`@import 'tailwindcss'`), PostCSS |
| UI | shadcn/ui (New York), Radix UI primitives, OKLCH theme |
| State | Zustand 5.x (local UI), Nuqs (URL params) |
| Forms | TanStack Form + Zod (`createFormHook`) |
| Data | TanStack React Query |
| Backend | Supabase (Auth, RLS, Edge Functions, pg_cron) |
| Integration | Google Drive/Calendar (service account) |
| Push | Web Push + PWA |
| AI Tools | ECC, graphify |
| Package | Bun (primary), npm (secondary) |

---

## Critical Conventions

### Data Fetching
- **React Query** for all data — `void prefetchQuery()` on server + `useSuspenseQuery` on client (standard TanStack pattern), `useMutation` for forms, `HydrationBoundary` + `dehydrate` for hydration, `<Suspense fallback>` for streaming
- **API layer** per feature — `api/types.ts` → `api/service.ts` → `api/queries.ts`; queries use key factories (`entityKeys.all/list/detail`); components import from service and queries, never from mock APIs directly

### Forms
- **`useAppForm`** from `@/lib/form` (TanStack `createFormHook`) + `form.AppField` rendering field components in `@/components/forms/fields` (`field.TextField`, `field.SelectField`, …); each component follows the shadcn TanStack Form doc anatomy; raw `form.Field` for one-off custom fields; form-level Zod `onSubmit` validators

### Routing & Params
- **nuqs** for URL search params — `searchParamsCache` on server, `useQueryStates` on client, use `getSortingStateParser` for sort (same parser as `useDataTable`)

### Styling
- **Icons** — only import from `@/components/icons`, never from `@tabler/icons-react` directly
- **Page headers** — use `PageContainer` props (`pageTitle`, `pageDescription`, `pageHeaderAction`), never import `<Heading>` manually
- **Formatting** — single quotes, JSX single quotes, no trailing comma, 2-space indent

## Agent Rules (from Contract C-03)

1. **One task per session** — pick from `docs/list-task-project.md`. No fitting task → append one with `status: backlog`.
2. **Change only `status` and `owner`** lines in the task list (C-03). Never set `done` — a human does that.
3. **Read before write** — `docs/system-overview.md` first, then only the file your task touches.
4. **Graph before grep** — `graphify query "<question>"` or skim `graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md`. Grep only when the graph misses.
5. **Write a history entry** — one JSON file in `agent-history/entries/` per session, even for failures.
6. **Separate branch per task** — branch name: `task/PSI-NNN`. Never work on `main`.
7. **No GCP/GCloud without permission** — never touch remote cloud infrastructure.
